authority: Domain profile only. It defines what evidence a user-experience proposal must contain; it may not invent product hierarchy, a universal action, brand direction, or feature priority.
applies_when: defining or changing navigation or home composition
defining or changing a user-facing journey
defining or changing brand, visual, interaction, or content systems
required_outputs: people, states, jobs, and permissions map
state-specific actions and open-action prompting rules
first, normal, empty, loading, error, recovery, and after states
explicit alternatives, rejected assumptions, and unresolved questions
evaluation_criteria: the proposal covers the accepted product scope and category baseline
hierarchy follows cited product decisions rather than a method preference
navigation remains understandable without an agent explaining it
open actions are contextual prompts rather than a forced universal entrance
visual and brand choices have a stated purpose and consistent system
normal, failure, recovery, and post-action states remain usable
real screens are reviewed at declared mobile and desktop viewports
accessibility requirements are tested against the accepted behavior
proving_evidence: traceability from each material choice to current authority or measured benchmark evidence
state and journey coverage mapped to observable acceptance criteria
real rendered screenshots and click-through observations at declared viewports
an independent requirement-bound review with failures and limitations recorded
forbidden_inferences: one action is best for every user, screen, or state
a dashboard, homebase, feed, wizard, or another pattern is inherently right or wrong
a design skill or benchmark example can override product authority
a visually polished screen proves feature, authority, or end-to-end completeness
repetition across derivative prompts is independent evidence

expected_outcome.statement: A complete, traceable experience definition that downstream design and implementation agents can execute without silently inventing product scope, hierarchy, or success criteria.
expected_outcome.failure: Return failed_verification or blocked with the missing authority, evidence, state coverage, or unresolved choice named explicitly.
expected_outcome.retry_exit: Repair only with a changed hypothesis or new evidence; exit when all declared criteria pass or the finite budget reaches a terminal state.
